## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Kalpataru Constructions?
Alsa Mall, 2nd Floor, No. 149/2, Montieth Road, Egmore, Chennai – 600 008.

### What facilities does Kalpataru Constructions have?
Apartments, Villas, Residential plots, Joint ventures, Land promotion & development, Commercial constructions, Turnkey constructions, Individual home construction, Interior design, CMDA/DTCP & RERA approved projects.

### Where is Guru Ganesh Avenue Phase IV?
At Varatharajapuram Village (Mannivakkam), just 200 m off the Mannivakkam – Padappai Main Road and 3 minutes from the Kilambakkam bus terminal. Plots range from 800 sq.ft to 1416 sq.ft.

### Are the projects approved?
Yes. Kalpataru says all its projects are approved by CMDA/DTCP and RERA approved.

### Does Kalpataru take up joint ventures?
Yes. Kalpataru is looking for good land parcels from landowners for joint development of apartments, villas and plotted developments.
